So that's intentional injury with a weapon, causing serious injury. Under Chinese Criminal Law, that is "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). Since the injury is serious (重伤), it may be "故意伤害罪，致人重伤". Also using a knife may be "持械伤人" but still under intentional injury. Also there is "聚众斗殴" maybe? They were a group of three vs two, but the main act is assault with a knife causing serious injury. No theft. "强行带离" is kidnapping. So "非法拘禁罪". Also "故意伤害罪" for the injuries.

Thus the crimes: 故意伤害罪;非法拘禁罪.

The facts support intentional injury and illegal detention. Also "持械伤人" is a specific form of intentional injury, but the name is still "故意伤害罪". So answer: [罪名]故意伤害;非法拘禁<eoa>
